chunks: "Cursed, cursed is the one who casts his burden upon the people. Cursed, cursed is the one who neglects those whom he supports."

key_terms.أَلْقَى: cast or threw; shifted onto others
key_terms.ضَيَّعَ: neglected, failed, or let go to waste
key_terms.مَلْعُونٌ: cursed; one deserving condemnation and divine rejection
key_terms.يَعُولُ: supports and maintains financially or as a dependent

ai.seo_question: What does the Imam عليه السلام say about burdening others and neglecting one's dependents?
ai.summary: This hadith condemns two blameworthy traits: making others carry one's own burdens and neglecting one's dependents. It emphasizes personal responsibility, proper care for those under one's maintenance, and the moral seriousness of failing in these duties.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "Cursed, cursed is the one who burdens others with his responsibilities. Cursed, cursed is the one who neglects those under his care."
